adjudication: The official Accessibility Scanner service bound on the approved Android 16 tablet, but its floating scan action did not create a scan record. This is recorded as an explicit scanner/tool compatibility limitation, not as a clean Scanner result. Candidate accessibility remains supported by the independent TalkBack binding/focus pass, hardware-keyboard focus traversal, native UI-tree semantics, 200 percent text inspection, and Standard/Enhanced redundant-cue evidence.
